**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

The document contains no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binding Northwind. It meets the **preferred** position:

- **§ 12.3** expressly confirms Customer may engage any supplier and "has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment."
- **§ 2.1** reinforces this: "No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies," and declining to enter another Order Form "is not a breach or shortfall."
- **§ 12.4** does restrain Vendor from marketing a competing analytics service — exclusivity running in our favour, which the rule treats as acceptable and not a deviation.

Targeted searches for "exclusive," "sole," and requirements-purchase phrasing surfaced only unrelated uses (non-exclusive licence in § 13, exclusive jurisdiction in § 28, exclusive remedy in §§ 19/21/30). Sections 2, 4, 7 and 12 were read in full and contain no buried order-commitment or sole-source language.
